description: Modbus RTU gateway for Toshiba air conditioners: on/off, mode, fan speed, vanes, setpoint, temperatures, alarms, error codes and gateway settings
source: HMS Networks / Intesis, INMBSTOS001R000 user manual

sources.title: INMBSTOS001R000 – Modbus RTU interface – User manual

notes: Modbus RTU over EIA-485. Function 03 or 04 reads, 06 or 16 writes. The baud rate and slave address are set with the DIP switches (factory: 9600 baud, 8N1).
Addresses are the protocol addresses of the manual (the PLC addresses less 1).
Temperatures are in °C or °F and in degrees or tenths of a degree, as set with the DIP switches; their entries say so.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: AC unit Temperature Setpoint
registers.description: -32768 (Initialization value) 16..32ºC (ºC/x10ºC) 61..90ºF Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: AC unit Temperature reference
registers.description: -32768: Initial value. Value invalid, which comes from the IU’s sensor. If the value that is shown in register 22 (23 PLC) is valid, the address is going to take this value. Ranges are specific from Manufacturer (ºC/x10ºC/ºF) Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: AC unit Operation Time
registers.description: 0..65535 (hours). Counts the time the AC unit is in “On” state.

registers.name: Error Code
registers.description: 0: No Error active 65535 (-1): Error in the communication of Gateway with the AC indoor unit. Any other error present, see the table at the end of this document.

registers.name: Indoor unit´s ambient temperature from external sensor (at Modbus side)
registers.description: -32768: Initialization value. No temperature is being provided from an input sensor. There’s no input sensor. Any other: (ºC/x10ºC/ºF) Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: AC Real temperature setpoint
registers.description: There’s no Virtual Temperature. The value equals to the value of register 5 (6 PLC). The value which is introduced by the user is the one that the machine uses (the external sensor is able to write directly over the machine to do this operation). Ran Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: “Open Window” switch-off timeout
